description: Where money is flowing and who is winning, buyers or sellers (Binance spot taker buys). Live: 'market' = across coins (each coin's Cash % = share of all buying, buyers % on 15m/1h/4h/12h/1d, market risk); 'coin' = one coin; 'group' = comma-separated coins. History (recorded every 15 min): 'changes' without symbol = cash pile (USDC share), Money gainers and the last 24h of changes (new money, all timeframes agree, red spreading, money out); 'changes' with symbol = that coin's rank today vs usual, last 7 daily ranks and its changes. Money gainers (a coin suddenly in the top 10 that is usually outside the top 20) is backtested: next 1–3 days +4.6 pts vs the market on average, fades after ~3 days — a place to look, not a buy signal. Use for 'where is money flowing', 'is money coming into X', 'what changed', trade ideas.

mode.description: market / coin / group = live now; changes = history (Money gainers, what changed)

symbol.description: Coin symbol (required for coin/group, optional for changes)
